content: Yinni Gusunɔ u derɑ swɑ̃ɑ bɑkɑ yɑ Yonɑsi mwɛ. Mɑ u kuɑ wɔ̃kuru itɑ kɑ sɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ itɑ swɑ̃ɑ yen nukurɔ.
Swɑ̃ɑ yen nukurun diyɑ Yonɑsi u Gusunɔ win Yinni kɑnɑ.

content.text: Yinni Gusunɔ, sɑnɑm mɛ nɑ wɑ̃ɑ nuku sɑnkirɑru sɔɔ,
nɑ nun nɔɔɡiru sue, mɑ ɑ mɑn wisɑ.
Sɑɑ ɡɔribun wɑ̃ɑ yerun di nɑ nun sokɑ.
Mɑ ɑ nɛn nɔɔ nuɑ.
Wee ɑ mɑn kpɛ̃ɛ sere nim wɔ̃kun sɔɔwɔ.
Mɑ nim mɑn mwɛ.
Nim kurenu kpuro mɑn tɑɑre.
Nɑ rɑɑ tii sɔ̃ɔmɔ nɑ mɔ̀, wee ɑ mɑn ɡirɑ wunɛn wuswɑɑn di,
nɑ dɑ sere mi n tomɑ.
Adɑmɑ wee tɛ̃, kon mɑɑ wunɛn sɑ̃ɑ yee dɛɛrɑru wɑ.
Nim mɑn mwɛ sere nɑ kĩ n ɡbi.
Mu mɑn wukiri, mɑ yɑkɑ si su wɑ̃ɑ mɛn sɔɔwɔ
su mɑn tɛ̃kusi sere wirɔ.
Nɑ numɑ nɑ dɑ sere ɡuunun kpɛɛkpɛɛkuɔ,
mɑ tem sɔɔwɔn ɡɑmbobɑ bɑ mɑn kɛnusi dim dim.
Adɑmɑ Gusunɔ nɛn Yinni, ɑ mɑn yɑrɑ min di wɑsiru.
Sɑnɑm mɛ nɑ kom yɑɑ biɑ
nɑ wunɛ Yinni Gusunɔ yɑɑyɑ,
mɑ ɑ nɛn kɑnɑru nuɑ wunɛn sɑ̃ɑ yee dɛɛrɑrun mi.
Be bɑ bũnu sɑ̃ɑmɔ, bɑ ǹ mɑɑ wunɛn durom wɑsi.
Adɑmɑ nɛ, kon nun yɑ̃kuru kuɑ.
Kon nun siɑrɑ,
kpɑ n nɛn nɔɔ mwɛɛru yibiɑ.
Yinni Gusunɔ, wunɑ ɑ rɑ mɑn fɑɑbɑ ko.

content: Sɑɑ yerɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u swɑ̃ɑ ye sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, yu doo yu Yonɑsi siɑ kɑsɑɔ. Mɑ swɑ̃ɑ ye, yɑ dɑ kɑsɑɔ yɑ Yonɑsi siɑ.
